/**
 * A Node file that follows every house rule.
 */
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import ts from 'typescript';
import type { Finding } from '../lint/finding.ts';
import { frameTime } from '../shared/clean-shared.ts';
import type { Timed } from '../shared/clean-shared.ts';

/** Log levels as a const object, the house replacement for enums. */
export const Levels = { quiet: 0, normal: 1 } as const;

/** One of the levels. */
export type Level = (typeof Levels)[keyof typeof Levels];

/** A documented interface. */
export interface Options {
  readonly level: Level;
  readonly root: string;
}

/** A documented class with explicit fields. */
export class Reader implements Timed {
  readonly frame: number;
  private readonly root: string;

  constructor(frame: number, root: string) {
    this.frame = frame;
    this.root = root;
  }

  /** Reads a file under the root. */
  read(name: string): string {
    return readFileSync(join(this.root, name), 'utf8');
  }

  /** Seconds for this reader's frame. */
  seconds(fps: number): number {
    return frameTime(this.frame, fps) + this.helper();
  }

  private helper(): number {
    return 1;
  }

  /** A documented static method. */
  static version(): string {
    return ts.version;
  }
}

/** An exported arrow with an explicit return type. */
export const describe = (finding: Finding): string => `${finding.rule}@${finding.line}`;

/** An async function. */
export async function later(value: number): Promise<number> {
  return value;
}

/** Overloads documented once. */
export function pick(value: string): string;
export function pick(value: number): number;
export function pick(value: string | number): string | number {
  return value;
}

const internal = (value: number) => value;

function alsoInternal(value: number) {
  return internal(value) + new Reader(0, '.').seconds(24);
}

/** A date with an argument, a timer and Math.random are fine outside page mode. */
export function nodeOnly(): number {
  setTimeout(() => {}, 1);
  return new Date(0).getTime() + Date.now() + alsoInternal(1) + Math.random();
}
